rows.title: Agent Harness Engineer (Remote)
rows.eligibility: Tier 1 - Ashby posting API returns location 'Europe' with isRemote true, so workable from Venice with no permit or move
rows.why: Building and hardening agent harnesses is the closest thing on any board this week to what he actually did at FlowSpace - production customer-support agents, a CV-parsing tool on n8n + Eden AI, and scraping/parsing agents that grew platform listings. The posting states no minimum years and asks only for prior agent-building experience, which is exactly how a 3-year candidate with shipped agents gets read seriously.
rows.watch_outs: Posted 98 days ago - live and listed, but ask early whether the req is still moving. Comp is a slogan, not a number, so he will have to anchor first. The company's other eight roles are all Warsaw on-site, so 'Remote' here is the exception and worth confirming in the first call. Small seed-stage team - do the usual funding diligence.

rows.title: AI Engineer - top 5% salary band in Europe
rows.location: Remote possible, Berlin Mitte office preferred several days a week
rows.eligibility: Tier 3 - the posting says remote is possible but prefers several days a week in Berlin Mitte, so treat it as a German hybrid role; his EU long-term residence permit means no sponsorship is needed if he does move
rows.comp: 'Top 5% salary band in Europe' plus VSOP - no figures published
rows.posted: 2026-03-29 (129d), page refreshed within the last hour
rows.why: Asks for 2+ years of development experience, which is one of the very few AI Engineer reqs on the boards that his ~3 years actually clears rather than stretches. Prompt engineering and shipping LLM features into a live product is directly his FlowSpace and OpenAI/Eden AI work, and Jamie is a product-is-AI company rather than a team bolting AI onto something else.
rows.watch_outs: Berlin office expectation several days a week is the real gate - clarify in the first message whether fully remote from Italy is genuinely on the table before investing in the process. The comp claim is unquantified. Role leans toward MLOps and AI pipeline optimisation, which is the thinnest part of his CV - lead with agents and shipped features, not infrastructure.

rows.title: (Remote) Founding Full-Stack Engineer
rows.location: Munich - 3 days per week in the central Munich office, flexible otherwise
rows.eligibility: Tier 3 - Relocation. Titled '(Remote)' but the body requires 3 days a week in Munich. No sponsorship needed given his EU long-term residence permit, but it is a move.
rows.comp: No salary stated - equity 0.5%-1.5%, 4-year vest with an 18-month cliff
rows.why: The stack is almost a line-by-line match to his last two years: TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase/Postgres, plus agent harnesses and streaming agents via LangChain and the Vercel AI SDK. He has already done the hard version of this - leading the migration of a live product from Bubble.io to Next.js + Laravel - and the posting explicitly says level is opportunistic, that they have 'seen brilliant new grads outperform staff engineers', which removes the years-of-experience filter that kills most founding-engineer applications for him.
rows.watch_outs: The '(Remote)' in the title is misleading - 3 days a week in Munich is a relocation, so score this on whether he would move. Equity-only disclosure with no salary band is a genuine gap to probe early. German is nice-to-have for customer conversations, explicitly not required. Very early stage - one of two or three engineers.

rows.title: Senior Fullstack Applied AI Engineer (f/m/x)
rows.eligibility: Tier 3 - Relocation. Fully remote but the posting scopes candidates to 'somewhere in Germany', so Venice does not qualify as-is. English fluency is the stated requirement and German is only a plus, so the language gate is clear.
rows.comp: EUR 75,000-85,000 per year plus VSOP participation
rows.why: Applied AI on a fullstack surface - TypeScript, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, React, LLM frameworks and vector databases - is the combination he can evidence end to end from FlowSpace and the OpenAI/Eden AI integrations, rather than a research role dressed up as engineering. Disclosed EUR 75-85k also gives him a concrete European band to calibrate every other conversation against, which nothing else verified this week does.
rows.watch_outs: Germany-residency scope is the blocker - worth one email asking whether they will engage an EU-resident contractor or use an EOR, since he invoices as a freelancer normally and that is often the unlock. 'Senior' with vector-database expectations is a slight stretch on a 3-year count. Company trades as MAIA but the join.com board is under the 'prodlane' slug - confirm the legal entity before applying.
